an8.39:1.1: aṭṭhime bhikkhave puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā sovaggikā sukhavipākā saggasaṃvattanikā iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
an8.39:1.3: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti
an8.39:1.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
an8.39:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti
an8.39:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti
an8.39:3.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
an8.39:3.3: pañcimāni bhikkhave dānāni mahādānāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṅkiṇṇāni asaṅkiṇṇapubbāni na saṅkiyanti na saṅkiyissanti appaṭikuṭṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an8.39:3.5: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti
an8.39:3.6: pāṇātipātā paṭivirato bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti averaṃ deti abyāpajjhaṃ deti
an8.39:3.7: aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā averaṃ datvā abyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa abyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti
an8.39:3.8: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ dānaṃ mahādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṅkiṇṇaṃ asaṅkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṅkiyati na saṅkiyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an8.39:3.9: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
an8.39:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti
an8.39:5.1: kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭirato hoti
an8.39:7.2: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti averaṃ deti abyāpajjhaṃ deti
an8.39:7.3: aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā averaṃ datvā abyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa abyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti
an8.39:7.4: idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ dānaṃ mahādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṅkiṇṇaṃ asaṅkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṅkiyati na saṅkiyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an8.39:7.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave aṭṭhamo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
an8.39:8.1: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā sovaggikā sukhavipākā saggasaṃvattanikā iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti. 40
